## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Look for a joint that is barely holding on. [t874]
- [Partial] Check if the vehicle shakes significantly at speed, indicating severe wear. [t874]
- Listen for a sound that mimics an exhaust leak. [t874]
- [Partial] Note if the noise gets quieter as speed increases, which is counter-intuitive but possible with bearing issues. [t874]
